product: Corporate Learning Progress, Intervention & Compliance Tracking System
scope_note: Focused learning progress, risk detection, intervention tracking, and compliance reporting product. Not a full LMS.

nfrs.requirement: Learner profile pages should load within 2 seconds for normal users.
nfrs.target: P95 page load <= 2 seconds

nfrs.requirement: Risk dashboard summary should load within 3 seconds for filtered views.
nfrs.target: P95 dashboard load <= 3 seconds

nfrs.requirement: Compliance reports for up to 10,000 learners should generate within 60 seconds.
nfrs.target: Report generation <= 60 seconds for 10,000 learners

nfrs.requirement: Standard API read/write operations should respond quickly, excluding large reports and imports.
nfrs.target: P95 API response <= 300 ms

nfrs.requirement: The system should support growth in employees, learning programs, competencies, assessments, and intervention records without redesign.
nfrs.target: Architecture supports modular scale-out and data growth

nfrs.requirement: The system should support concurrent dashboard and profile access.
nfrs.target: At least 500 concurrent users

nfrs.requirement: The data model should support historical learning, risk, and intervention data.
nfrs.target: 3-5 years of historical records

nfrs.requirement: The system should be available for business-hour usage.
nfrs.target: 99.5% availability

nfrs.requirement: Data ingestion jobs should be retryable and should not create duplicate records.
nfrs.target: Retryable ingestion with idempotency controls

nfrs.requirement: Failed imports should be captured with clear error reasons and reprocessing support.
nfrs.target: 100% failed import records have error reason and retry path

nfrs.requirement: Attendance, assessment, employee, and competency data must be validated before acceptance.
nfrs.target: Validation applied to all inbound learning records

nfrs.requirement: Duplicate, incomplete, and inconsistent records must be flagged for review.
nfrs.target: Data quality exceptions visible in import monitoring

nfrs.requirement: Risk classification must be traceable to the exact rule version and source data used.
nfrs.target: Risk result stores rule version and source data references

nfrs.requirement: Access must be role-based across learners, trainers, managers, L&D administrators, compliance officers, and system administrators.
nfrs.target: RBAC plus scoped access checks for learner data

nfrs.requirement: Sensitive employee learning and performance data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
nfrs.target: TLS for transit and encryption at rest for storage

nfrs.requirement: Exports, report generation, rule changes, intervention updates, and admin actions must be audit logged.
nfrs.target: Audit log coverage for all sensitive actions

nfrs.requirement: Users should only see learner data they are authorized to access.
nfrs.target: Access scoped by role, department, manager relationship, or assigned program

nfrs.requirement: Compliance reports must include timestamp, filters used, source references, and generated-by information.
nfrs.target: Report metadata included in every compliance report

nfrs.requirement: Historical records must be retained according to organizational and regulatory policies.
nfrs.target: Configurable retention policy

nfrs.requirement: The system must preserve history for rule changes, risk status changes, interventions, manual corrections, and report exports.
nfrs.target: Historical audit trail for all compliance-relevant changes

nfrs.requirement: Risk rules should be configurable without code deployment.
nfrs.target: Authorized business users can create, test, activate, deactivate, and version rules

nfrs.requirement: Data ingestion, risk rules, intervention tracking, reporting, and dashboards should be separated as clear modules or services.
nfrs.target: Clear module boundaries and ownership

nfrs.requirement: The system should allow future addition of new data sources, rule types, report formats, and intervention types.
nfrs.target: Extension points for source adapters, rule conditions, report templates, and intervention types

nfrs.requirement: The system should provide logs, metrics, health checks, import status, job status, and alerting for failures.
nfrs.target: Operational telemetry for APIs, jobs, imports, reports, and integrations

nfrs.requirement: Dashboards should show clear risk reasons, not just risk labels.
nfrs.target: Each risk status displays triggered rule and reason

nfrs.requirement: Trainers and L&D administrators should be able to find at-risk learners and create interventions with minimal steps.
nfrs.target: At-risk learner to intervention creation flow <= 3 main steps

nfrs.requirement: APIs should use documented contracts for attendance, assessment, competency, employee, and intervention data.
nfrs.target: Versioned API contracts for all inbound and outbound integrations

nfrs.requirement: The system should support regular backups and tested restore procedures.
nfrs.target: Scheduled backups with periodic restore validation

nfrs.requirement: The application should support repeatable deployment across development, test, staging, and production environments.
nfrs.target: Automated deployment process with environment-specific configuration

highest_priority_nfrs.reason: Risk classification and compliance reports depend on trusted learning records.
Employee learning performance data is sensitive and must be protected.
Compliance reporting requires evidence of source data, rule versions, actions, and exports.
Risk rules must change without engineering effort or code deployment.
The product depends on data from external LMS, assessment, HR, and trainer systems.
The product creates value only when trainers and L&D administrators can take timely action.
